items.title: Viral AI assistant Instinct now has its own email address

items.title: Sequoia doubles down on Cymphony as AI agents create new enterprise security risks

items.title: Suno replaces its AI models with a new one trained on licensed music as copyright suits pile up
items.feed_excerpt: As it grapples with a bevy of lawsuits, Suno said its new model, Suno v6, is not trained using music it used to train previous versions of the AI model.

items.feed_excerpt: Most notably, Apple is taking aim at the growing wave of AI wearables with new "Audio Intelligence" features that let you rewind moments and remember details from daily conversations.

items.title: Apple has a new way prove your iPhone photos aren’t AI slop
items.feed_excerpt: Apple introduced Apple Reference Image to help users determine whether photos have been edited, including alterations made by AI.
